settings.heading: Before you order
settings.subheading: Anything else? Email sales@optiqservice.com — we reply within one business day.

settings.question: How do you program my review link?
settings.answer: At checkout you'll enter your business name and Google review link. We program the chip, tap-test it, and ship it ready to use. If you'd rather send the link later, just email it to sales@optiqservice.com with your order number.

settings.question: What if I don't know my Google review link?
settings.answer: Order anyway — we'll email you a 2-minute guide to finding it, or find it for you if you share your business name and city.

settings.question: Do my customers need an app?
settings.answer: No. NFC reading is built into modern iPhones and Android phones. Customers just hold their phone near the card.

settings.question: Does it guarantee 5-star reviews?
settings.answer: No — nothing legitimately can. The card makes leaving a review dramatically easier; what customers write is up to them. Great service does the rest.

settings.heading: Put it on the counter. Let the taps do the asking.
